summary: Tested backend prayer-times APIs (4/5 pass) and frontend flows (LocationSetup → HomePage → tasks/achievements/change-location). Backend core endpoints work. Frontend renders correctly in Arabic RTL with Tajawal font and no human/animal faces. However, three integration issues were found: (1) prayer card toggle does not update XP/streak in StatsBar, (2) AddTaskDialog submit button lacks a discoverable data-testid so task creation flow could not be completed via automation, (3) Achievements dialog did not appear to open via [role=dialog] selector when clicking the trophy button.

minor.issue: Returns 200 for clearly invalid cities (e.g., 'ZzzNotARealCity123' / 'Nowhere'). Aladhan upstream returns success, so backend should validate or surface a 404/422 when timings look invalid.

ui_bugs.issue: Submit/add button has no recognizable data-testid (tried submit-task-btn, add-task-submit, save-task-btn). Task could not be submitted via automation; task list count stayed at 0.
Clicking [data-testid='open-achievements-btn'] did not produce a visible [role='dialog'] (count=0 after 600ms). Either dialog uses a different role or button click is intercepted.
Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent'. Add DialogDescription for accessibility.

integration_issues.issue: After clicking [data-testid='prayer-card-fajr'], StatsBar still shows '0 نقطة خبرة' and '0 أيام متتالية'. Expected +20 XP and streak bump per HomePage.handlePrayerToggle. Either the card root click isn't wired to onToggle, or there is an inner toggle element that wasn't triggered.

action_items: Fix prayer toggle: ensure PrayerCard's onToggle fires on the primary tap target and StatsBar re-renders with new XP/streak.
Expose submit button in AddTaskDialog with data-testid='submit-task-btn' (and verify task is persisted to localStorage and shown under the chosen slot).
Verify AchievementsPanel dialog opens; ensure Radix Dialog renders [role='dialog'] and add DialogDescription to silence aria-describedby warning.
Optionally validate Aladhan response server-side and return 404 for clearly invalid cities.
critical_code_review_comments: HomePage.handlePrayerToggle untoggle branch uses stale closure state `stats` for XP subtraction instead of reading latest stats; can cause negative drift.

storage.bumpStreak mutates the object returned by getStats then saves – fine, but HomePage doesn't store the returned object, so streak is only reflected on next render via getStats elsewhere. Confirm StatsBar receives updated streak.
server.py: invalid city handling relies entirely on Aladhan; consider checking timings sanity or `data.code != 200` before returning success.
AddTaskDialog and AchievementsPanel components were not viewed in this iteration – ensure they expose data-testid on submit and dialog content.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and pass 4/5 (invalid-city test failing because Aladhan returns 200). Frontend RTL/Tajawal/mascot/popular cities/change-location all verified. Remaining flows to re-test once main agent fixes the three integration bugs: prayer toggle XP, AddTaskDialog submit, AchievementsPanel dialog.
rca of the issue: Prayer toggle: likely the click handler is bound to an inner element (e.g., a checkbox circle) and clicking the card root doesn't propagate to onToggle. AddTaskDialog submit: button likely uses text 'إضافة' without data-testid. Achievements: button click may not be opening Radix Dialog due to event bubbling from sticky header or showAchievements state not being applied; needs source inspection of AchievementsPanel/HomePage Dialog wiring.
